definitions.explanation: A grass-like rush plant whose dried stems are woven into the facing of tatami mats.

examples.japanese: {畳|たたみ}は{藺草|いぐさ}で{作|つく}られる。
{藺草|いぐさ}のいい{香|かお}りがする。
examples.english: There is a pleasant scent of rush.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{畳|たたみ}の{藺草|いぐさ}の{香|かお}りは、{心|こころ}を{落|お}ち{着|つ}かせてくれる。
examples.english: The scent of the rush in a new tatami mat has a calming effect.

notes:
A rush plant whose dried stems are woven into the facing of {畳|たたみ} (tatami mats). The fresh, grassy scent of new tatami comes from {藺草|いぐさ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {藺草|いぐさ}の{香|かお}り: the scent of rush
- {藺草|いぐさ}を{織|お}る: to weave rush

USAGE:
Often written in kana (いぐさ). The main production area in Japan is Kumamoto Prefecture.
